R/ VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN ; R/ VICTORIA AVGGG

A copper alloy Roman Nummus from the 4th century AD, of uncertain mint. It is either one of two Reece Periods, but the coin's legend is too damaged to ascribe a period. It is either the R17 period, VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN reverse type, or R20, VICTORIA AVGGG reverse type. The obverse has a diademed bust, draped, with ...[AN]... The reverse contains two victories facing each other, holding wreaths.…
